post.title: Reported job scam losses grew 5x from 2020 to 2024
post.ig:
Reported job scam losses grew fivefold from 2020 to 2024.

FTC: reported losses to job scams went from $90 million in 2020 to $501 million in 2024.
Across all fraud, reported losses hit a record $15.9 billion in 2025.
The common asks: pay for equipment, pay for training, or deposit money to unlock earnings.
The FTC: "Honest employers, including the federal government, will never ask you to pay to get a job."

Sources: FTC Consumer Sentinel data (March 2025), FTC Data Spotlight (December 2024), FTC testimony (March 2026), FTC job scams guidance.
News and education, not financial advice.

post.yt_desc:
Job offer scams flip the money the wrong way: you pay for equipment, training, or a deposit to unlock earnings. FTC data show reported job scam losses grew from $90 million in 2020 to $501 million in 2024, and reported losses to all fraud hit a record $15.9 billion in 2025. The FTC says honest employers, including the federal government, will never ask you to pay to get a job. Sources: FTC (December 2024, March 2025, March 2026).

News and education, not financial advice.
